title: The workflow I kept repeating—and how vincent was born
seo_title: How repeated QA workflows led to vincent
description: See how a repeated QA-to-fix workflow—validate, reproduce, test, document, review, open a PR, and update the ticket—led to vincent.
image_alt: The workflow I kept repeating—and how vincent was born

title: Spend inference only where it belongs
seo_title: Cost-effective agentic workflows with deterministic commands
description: Learn how vincent keeps deterministic work in commands and reserves costly agent inference for the changes that actually require reasoning.
image_alt: Spend inference only where it belongs

title: “Done” is not a success condition
seo_title: Why agentic work needs deterministic success checks
description: Learn why agentic workflows need explicit checks, tests, and success criteria instead of accepting an agent's claim that the work is done.

title: Automation without giving up control
seo_title: Human approval gates for safe agentic automation
description: See how vincent combines automated execution with human approval gates for review, release, and other consequential decisions.

title: The terminal should not own the work
seo_title: Durable AI agent execution beyond terminal sessions
description: Learn how vincent moves coding-agent work out of fragile terminal sessions and into durable tasks that survive disconnects and restarts.
image_alt: The terminal should not own the work

title: Failure should be a state, not a dead end
seo_title: Recoverable agent workflows with retained context
description: See how vincent models failures as recoverable workflow states, retaining logs, context, and worktrees for retry, takeover, or investigation.
image_alt: Failure should be a state, not a dead end

title: One task, one branch, no checkout traffic jam
seo_title: Isolated git worktrees for concurrent coding agents
description: Learn how vincent uses isolated git worktrees so multiple coding-agent tasks can run concurrently without branch switching or file conflicts.
image_alt: One task, one branch, no checkout traffic jam

title: A workflow is executable team knowledge
seo_title: Versioned agent workflows as executable team knowledge
description: See how versioned vincent workflows turn recurring engineering practices into reviewable, reusable, and executable team knowledge.
image_alt: A workflow is executable team knowledge

title: Bring your agent, keep your control plane
seo_title: Orchestrate Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor locally
description: Use Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor behind vincent's local control plane while keeping workflow policy, state, and evidence independent of one agent.

title: From a wall of terminals to one control room
seo_title: A control room for concurrent coding-agent workloads
description: See how vincent replaces a wall of agent terminals with one control room for concurrent tasks, live output, approvals, diffs, and recovery.
